notes:
K8Secret 0.6.3 — the update hands you the tour.

The release notes offered the guided tour behind a button labelled "Not now", which reads as a deferral, so the tour was easy to miss on the one occasion it is most useful: the update that rebuilt the interface. Taking it is now the default action — Return starts it — with the minute it costs stated beside the buttons, and skipping is recorded as an answer rather than a question the app repeats on the next patch.

The tour itself walks the real window: the rail, the namespace menu, ⌘K, secrets and the cluster switcher, each spotlit where it actually sits. Settings keeps it for whenever you want it again.
